newsitem.title: CANADA: Cineplex settles strike with projectionists.
newsitem.headline: Cineplex settles strike with projectionists.

text.p: Cineplex Odeon Corp. said Monday it forged a deal with striking projectionists from the International Alliance of Theatrical Stage Employees (IATSE), who have been locked out since Oct. 28.
"We are pleased to have reached an amicable resolution with Local 173," said Cineplex President Allen Karp. "We look forward to the projectionists coming back to work."
The theatre chain owner said the members of IATSE Local 173 are scheduled to return to work Feb. 25, pending ratification of the new agreement.

Cineplex said it offered full time employment to 42 of the 70-75 full-time projectionists and a 15 percent to 17 percent reduction in wages to a range from C$25,480 to C$29,120 a year. It also offered a severance package of up 26 weeks of pay and a C$200,000 job re-training fund which will provide up to C$6,000 per worker.
Cineplex said the reduction in wages and workers was a reflection of changes in the projectionists' working environment, which has become increasingly automated.
